authorization_basis: Owner authorized the exact G1-METADATA-2 scope in the project session.
permitted_outputs: artifact filenames, hashes and sizes from official metadata
XPU wheel headers obtained with HEAD
download, cache and installation estimates when evidence supports them
new versioned metadata lock without overwriting the previous lock
payload_policy: GET bodies are limited to PyPI/GitHub JSON metadata, package PEP 658 .metadata files and PyTorch index HTML. Wheel, sdist, archive, executable, model and dataset payloads are prohibited. The three XPU wheel URLs may be inspected only with HEAD.
